theme.title: Stockton to Malone
theme.subtitle: Utah Jazz, 1984–2003
theme.recap: John Stockton and Karl Malone played together longer than any teammates, and Stockton barely missed a game.

questions.prompt: In 1989–90 John Stockton set the NBA record for assists per game in a season. What was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: As of 2019, Stockton also held the record for assists-per-game average over one season (14.5 in 1990).

funFacts.text: Stockton led the league in assists for nine consecutive seasons, an extraordinary run of consistency.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading the NBA in assists per game, which he would do for nine consecutive seasons

funFacts.text: He produced at least 1,000 assists in a single season on seven separate occasions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton accomplished this feat seven times

funFacts.text: Stockton ended his playing career with 15,806 assists, far ahead of other point guards.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: career assists with 15,806

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did John Stockton and Karl Malone play together?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The two played a record 1,412 regular season games together as teammates

funFacts.text: The partnership led Utah to consecutive NBA Finals appearances against Michael Jordan's Bulls.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton and his longtime teammate Karl Malone led the Jazz to the NBA Finals

funFacts.text: Their relentless pick-and-roll became a signature feature of the Jazz attack.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton and Malone have been described as the greatest pick-and-roll combination of all time

funFacts.text: Utah retired Stockton's No. 12 jersey in 2004.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton's number 12 jersey was retired by the Jazz during a game on November 22, 2004

questions.prompt: Over 19 seasons, how many games did John Stockton miss?
questions.note: Just 22. He played every game in 17 seasons.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: missing only 22 games in his 19-season career and playing every game of 17 seasons

funFacts.text: Stockton had completed 17 full seasons without missing a single game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: playing every game of 17 seasons

funFacts.text: His most significant injury was a left-knee MCL problem that kept him out at the start of 1997–98.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: due to an injured MCL in his left knee sustained in the preseason

funFacts.text: He was still Utah's starting point guard when he retired at age 41.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He remained a starting NBA player until his retirement at age 41

questions.prompt: John Stockton's career high in assists came on January 15, 1991. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 15, 1991, Stockton scored 20 points and dished out a career-high and franchise-record 28 assists

source.quote: Stockton scored 20 points and dished out a career-high

funFacts.text: In 1995, Stockton passed Magic Johnson to become the league's all-time assists leader.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he passed Magic Johnson (who had 9,921 assists) as the NBA's all-time leader in assists

questions.prompt: Karl Malone never won an NBA title. How many playoff games did he play?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He holds an NBA record for having played the most playoff games without winning a championship (193)

funFacts.text: Malone joined the Lakers in search of his first ring, alongside fellow veteran Gary Payton.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Lakers signed veteran stars Gary Payton and Karl Malone

funFacts.text: Detroit upset the heavily favored Lakers and won the championship in five games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the underdog Pistons handily won the series in five games

funFacts.text: A knee injury meant Malone could not dress for the decisive Finals game.
